title: Sky, night, fog and grade in Rust: a setting sun, the moon, the look's fog, the grade last
note: Under Environment::sky the time of day is the white sun's elevation and night is that sun set with a moon; depth and mist are the look's fog; the grade comes last, in code on top of genex.toml's look via RenderConfig::from_build.
intent: Build the outdoor look in order and capture after each step. Sky and sun: frame.environment(Environment::Sky(SkyParams::default()..)) with a white frame.sun whose elevation is the time of day (5 to 12 degrees up is a golden hour); for night keep the sun's intensity and let it go below the horizon, the stars come out (.with_stars) and .with_moon(Some(Moon::new(direction))) put opposite the sun is a full moon that lights the ground. Exposure: exposure = "auto" with ev_compensation = 0.5 in [render.look], and .exposure_curve(&[(-8.0, -6.0), (0.0, 0.0)]) so the night stays darker than the day instead of being metered up to grey. Air: depth, haze and mist are the look's fog, Fog::default().with_density(0.02).with_height(0.3, 0.0), never stacked transparent planes; on high and ultra it is a lit volume with sun shafts (.with_volumetric(false) keeps the plain height fog), so check that the near ground keeps its colour. Grade last and only for taste: .grading(Grading::NEUTRAL.with_vibrance(1.1)) or .temperature(0.3, 0.0) for warmth, never to fix light. A config set in code replaces [render], so start it from RenderConfig::from_build() to keep the toml's look and per-class wishes. Check a capture at noon, at dusk and at night, at high and as mobile-mid.
port: The facet that owns the time of day owns frame.sun, frame.environment and the moon; the facet that owns the options or the game's setup owns the one game.render_settings call.

evidence.note: The sun's elevation under the physical sky, the stars and the moon at night, the fog lit as a volume on high and ultra.
Grade last; RenderConfig::from_build keeps [render]; exposure_curve keeps a dusk dark.
Sky and sun first, the air is the look's fog, grade last.
